description: One-hour VLIW campaign for Goal Plus + Pi through Pi's built-in zai/glm-5.2 provider, with two live workers.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the campaign evaluates Goal Plus hosted by Pi through Pi's built-in ZAI provider
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local campaign uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the campaign evaluates Pi's built-in zai/glm-5.2 model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: high reasoning is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the requested per-task exploration budget is one hour
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: R=1 uses one outer Goal Plus trajectory and maps K=2 to internal workers
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: C=1 runs one task cell at a time
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
protocol_override_reasons.eval_interval: the one-hour run checks hidden-Judge progress every five minutes
protocol_override_reasons.internet: the Pi API provider and task dependency path require the validated open-network container path
